notes:
- Gemini 4 Carbon is now available alongside Gemini 4 Argon. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite remains the default model.
- In app versions that support the server model list, Carbon appears after that list refreshes. Older versions may not show it.
- Carbon uses the same component-based token pricing as Argon: introductory reference 11× until December 1, 2026 at 08:00 China Standard Time (UTC+8), then standard 23×. Actual deductions distinguish input, output/thinking, and cached tokens rather than applying one flat multiplier.
- In-app purchase prices are unchanged.

- Text-token deductions are lower: server reference multipliers change from 5× to 3× for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, 9× to 5× for Gemini 3.8 Flash, and 23× to 11× for Gemini 4 Argon during its introductory period (standard: 46× to 23×). The reductions differ by model, not a uniform 50% discount.
- Actual deductions still price input, output (including thinking), and cached tokens separately; the reference multiplier is not one flat rate for every token.
- In-app purchase prices are unchanged.
